authorization: Independent exact-source and exact-resource security/final approval plus native database gate; this contract is scope, not execution permission.
effects: Ordinary existing-account password login/getUser/admin read and local signout; provider authentication/audit effects remain. Database transaction is READ ONLY; ROLLBACK and connection close on every opened transaction.
prohibitions: No SQL writes or EXPLAIN ANALYZE DML
No account creation/elevation or fabricated JWT
No migration apply, schema, ACL, policy or worker change
No row contents, predicates, subjects, email or credentials in output
output: New private regular file opened O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW, mode0600; numeric allowlisted plan metadata only; stdout booleans/counts only.
retirement: After4427 acceptance retain reusable guard module; retire or consolidate this issue-specific contract under the same issue without weakening guards.
